creator: Bibliothecarius Modernus
method: Two independent visual readings of the HAB 2000 px page images (text block cut into three overlapping strips): Pass 1 = general-purpose Claude agent (Phase 9A sizing draft, 2026-09-14), Pass 2 = one fresh general-purpose Claude agent per folio with no access to Pass 1 or any edition (Phase 9B, 2026-09-14); word-level alignment by tools/transcription_benchmark.py; every disagreement re-cut at line level and adjudicated on the image by the operator (Claude Fable 5.1 session) before any parallel was consulted; then a full re-read of the reconciled text against the images by the operator. No OCR/HTR service, no paid vision model, no metered call.
normalization: MANUSCRIPT_TRANSCRIPTION_STANDARD.md v1.0: reading text; abbreviations expanded silently following the scribe's own full spellings (ihesus, michi, sacietas); scribe's spelling kept (e for ae; anglice, aucmentationem, adtende, inponentes, asselli, pharisayca, distinguntur as written); u/v by position, i only; capitals only where the scribe wrote them; modern punctuation by the transcriber (the scribe's points are kept in the line-level working files); red paragraph marks as ¶; rubrics in ›…‹; folio boundaries as [f. Nr]; \…/ = scribal interlinear addition; ⟨?⟩ = uncertain reading or expansion; (sic) = scribal error kept.
